about.title: About
description: I've been working as a software engineer since 2019, but my journey in technology began in 2017 when I started my Bachelor's degree in Information Systems. During college, I participated in extension, research, and teaching projects that strengthened my technical foundation and broadened my perspective on software development.

Throughout this period, I gained experience in different areas of technology, ranging from data structures to web, mobile, and desktop application development, building a solid foundation across multiple languages and programming paradigms.

My professional career began with an internship, where I experienced business-oriented software development firsthand. I learned how development teams collaborate, how responsibilities are divided, and how to apply the knowledge I've gained at university. I worked primarily with PHP, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS while learning software development best practices and system maintenance.

Over the years, I shifted my focus towards modern technologies and cloud infrastructure. I made my knowledge of JavaScript, React, React Native, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) deeper while also gaining experience maintaining and modernizing legacy systems.

Most recently, I worked with React, TypeScript, and AWS as part of agile development teams. I also became more involved in software architecture, sprint planning alongside the Product Owner, and cloud infrastructure.
I'm a fast learner who enjoys exploring new technologies and continuously improving my skills to keep up with the ever-evolving tech industry.

description.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Designed and implemented an workflow for signing documents, which includes PDF creation, automated signature requests, webhook based status check, signed document storage and notification, eliminating manual document handling across 100+ documents monthly.

Managed AWS Infrastructure in production and test environments, by configuring DNS, SSL/TLS certificates, load balancing, caching and application resilience while setting CI/CD pipelines in AWS CodePipeline to automate the lifecycle, from build to deployment.

Cooperated with the Product Owner to the evaluation of feasibility, scope and tradeoffs in new initiatives, independently researching for new solutions and integration possibilities with legacy and existing systems, providing technical expertise to influence the costs, timelines and sprint planning decisions.
Built REST APIs with Nest.js and PostgreSQL for implementation of core business workflows and integrations, while maintaining reliable data handling.

Developed responsive interfaces using React and a shared design system between internal systems, improving UI consistency and development efficiency while using caching, containerization, and automated testing to support application performance and reliability.
